title: Yeasty Vietnamese Lamb Loin Chops Bo Kho
description: A quick and flavorful Vietnamese dish featuring lamb loin chops, served in a yeasty, crisp broth. Serve with rice or noodles for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: yeast
ingredients.notes: instant dry yeast, active dry yeast or saffron may also work

instructions: Combine lamb loin chops and 1 tsp caraway seeds in a large bowl; set aside.
In a small saucepan, combine white vinegar, fish sauce, soy sauce, honey, garlic cloves, lemongrass stalk, and ginger. Heat over low heat, whisking until yeast is dissolved.
Pour the yeast mixture over the lamb loin chops and toss to coat; let marinate for 15 minutes.

Bring a large skillet or saucepan to medium-high heat. Remove lamb loin chops from marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off. Cook lamb loin chops for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked to desired doneness. Transfer lamb loin chops to a plate and set aside.
Add water to the skillet or saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until the broth has reduced slightly and thickened. Season with additional fish sauce, soy sauce, or honey to taste.
Slice cooked lamb loin chops into thin medallions. Serve with yeasty broth and garnish with additional lemongrass if desired.
Garnish with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
